structured.answer: Joining is worth it: I put in 750 ₪ a month, the employer puts in 2,250 ₪, and after 5 years about 136,457 ₪ would be left in my hands. But taking it out before 6 years costs about 64,761 ₪ in tax, so better to wait 6 years.
